preconditions.name: mech448_demotion_lever_live_and_excluding_both_arms
preconditions.description: The MECH-448 f_eligibility-demotion conversion constant (matched on BOTH arms) is ACTIVE on >= DEMOTION_ACTIVE_FRAC_FLOOR of P2 ticks AND it ACTUALLY EXCLUDES on the divergent e2_world_forward pool (mean f_eligibility_excluded_count > EXCLUDED_COUNT_FLOOR), on a majority of seeds in BOTH arms. An all-admit envelope (excluded_count==0; a flat-F pool) means the demotion did nothing -> the conversion constant is vacuous => substrate_not_ready_requeue (do NOT score the falsifier), NEVER a false weakens. preconditions.control: f_demotion envelope active-frac + excluded_count on both arms (matched lever)

preconditions.name: mech449_active_nogo_live_and_suppressing_both_arms
preconditions.description: The MECH-449 Go/No-Go eligibility constitution (matched on BOTH arms) is ACTIVE on >= NOGO_ACTIVE_FRAC_FLOOR of P2 ticks AND it ACTUALLY SUPPRESSES -- removes candidates from the F-eligible set (mean per-tick go_nogo_n_safety_nogo + go_nogo_n_soft_applied > NOGO_SUPPRESSED_FLOOR; the soft path is the MECH-260 perseveration No-Go fed by the dACC recency-share vector with use_dacc=True), on a majority of seeds in BOTH arms. An inert No-Go (nothing suppressed; the perseveration axis never crosses gng_perseveration_floor) means the active opponency leg did nothing -> the conversion constant is vacuous => substrate_not_ready_requeue (do NOT score the falsifier), NEVER a false weakens. preconditions.control: Go/No-Go constitution active-frac + suppressed-count on both arms (matched lever)

preconditions.name: lateral_pfc_route_range_supra_floor_and_sample_adequate_both_arms
preconditions.description: V3-EXQ-851 (ARC-062 P-A erratum fix): modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc' identity-routes the SD-033a rule-apprehension bias (_bdc_lpfc, the SAME channel use_candidate_rule_field differentiates) into _modulatory_accum. On a majority of seeds in BOTH arms (routing is a matched constant, not swept -- unlike 791a's single ARM_1): (a) the routed range's mean clears ROUTE_RANGE_SEED_FLOOR; (b) the GENUINE fresh-selection sample (latch-cleared, 791a pattern) clears FRESH_SELECT_FLOOR (cadence-derived worst-case: nominal P2 window ticks / beta_rate_max_steps); (c) the fresh-select YIELD clears FRESH_SELECT_YIELD_FLOOR (the same cadence bound as a truncation-invariant fraction of the observed window). An unrouted or under-sampled channel means the C2 committed-class DV cannot be attributed to routing => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a false weakens. Mirrors the V3-EXQ-791a route-range + sample-adequacy P0 gates.
preconditions.control: modulatory_channel_route_range + n_p2_fresh_select on both arms (matched lever)

evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-851 ARC-062 conversion-fanout GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-A (H1: selection-authority coupling gap; MECH-309 / ARC-062). Design of record: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2. Matched-stack base identical to V3-EXQ-654j (SP-CEM, GAP-A e2_world_forward candidate summaries, MECH-448 rank-preserving F->eligibility demotion, MECH-449 active Go/No-Go opponency, the CRF/LateralPFCAnalog rule-apprehension stack; SD-033a bias head un-zeroed AND TRAINED in a frozen-encoder P1 REINFORCE window). THE ONE CHANGE vs 654j: modulatory_channel_route_source changed from 654j's 'cand_world_summary' to 'lateral_pfc' -- now routing the SAME channel use_candidate_rule_field differentiates (_bdc_lpfc), not an unrelated channel. This corrects an ERRATUM in the design doc's original Leg P-A spec, which had specified 'gated_policy' on the false premise that it routes the rule-apprehension channel's own range; 'gated_policy' actually routes the unrelated ARC-062 Phase-1 GatedPolicy module's bias (no connection to LateralPFCAnalog/CandidateRuleField -- see that module's own docstring). The substrate fix (a new modulatory_channel_route_source=='lateral_pfc' branch in REEAgent.select_action, identity-routing _bdc_lpfc) landed ree-v3 as chip chip-20260731-arc062-pa-lpfc-route-source before this script was authored. Swept variable UNCHANGED: use_candidate_rule_field (ARM_OFF legacy collapsed rule_state vs ARM_ON matured+active differentiated crf_source). PRIMARY DV = COMMITTED-CLASS entropy. C1 (non-vacuity, mirrors 654j C1a-f exactly) = class axis exercisable AND GAP-A divergence (both arms) AND ARM_ON matured (crf_frac_active >= 0.3) AND propagation non-vacuous AND the MECH-448 demotion lever LIVE (active >= 0.8 of P2 ticks AND excluded_count > 0.0, both arms) AND the MECH-449 active No-Go LIVE and SUPPRESSING (active >= 0.8 of P2 ticks AND mean per-tick safety+soft suppressions > 0.0, both arms) AND (NEW C1g) the lateral_pfc-routed range clears 0.01 AND the latch-cleared fresh-selection sample clears 600 (yield >= 0.05), both arms. C2 (PRIMARY) = paired-by-seed ARM_ON > ARM_OFF committed-class entropy strict-above-by-margin (>= 2/3 seeds). interpretation_label=substrate_not_ready_requeue. C1=False, C2=False. ONLY the PASS branch weights MECH-309/ARC-062 (as supports); C1-fail (including the new C1g) self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue AND C1-holds-C2-fail self-routes conversion_ceiling_persists_despite_active_nogo -- H1 (selection-authority coupling gap) is REFUTED as the ceiling, portfolio weight shifts to H2 (Leg P-B, F-dominance) / H3 (Leg P-C, competence) -- BOTH non_contributory, NEITHER a falsification (NO weakens branch, matching 654j's own outcome map exactly). PROMOTES NOTHING by itself.

secondary_negative_control_not_load_bear.note: Within-class-representative entropy is a NEGATIVE CONTROL: the rule bias is class-keyed (per-candidate summary first-action-keyed; compute_bias broadcasts one rule_state across K), so it cannot move within-class selection -> ARM_ON ~ ARM_OFF is EXPECTED here, confirming the rule-creator's signal lives in the committed-class axis (the load-bearing C2 DV).

interpretation_grid.PASS_C1_C2: GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-A, H1 CONFIRMED: with the rule-apprehension channel's OWN cross-candidate range (lateral_pfc, _bdc_lpfc) now CORRECTLY routed into the modulatory-bias-selection-authority accumulator (C1g clears -- route_range supra-floor, adequate fresh-selection sample, both arms), the non-Bayesian rule-creator's DIFFERENTIATED + MATURED rule_state propagates to greater committed-class diversity than the collapsed legacy baseline, under the same MECH-448/449 matched stack 654j's cand_world_summary-routed predecessor could not convert with -> closes behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-I via the coupling-gap fix, not the constitution alone. supports MECH-309 + ARC-062. Route to /governance: MECH-309 / ARC-062 supports evidence; consider GAP-B + GAP-I closure; the H2 (Leg P-B) / H3 (Leg P-C) fanout legs become confirmatory rather than load-bearing.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_C1_holds_C2_fails: GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-A, H1 REFUTED as the ceiling: C1 fully holds -- class axis exercisable, GAP-A divergence real, ARM_ON minted distinct rules + matured + MAINTAINED, propagation non-vacuous (the bias REACHES committed action), the MECH-448 demotion lever LIVE, the MECH-449 active No-Go LIVE and SUPPRESSING, AND (NEW, the erratum fix) the lateral_pfc-routed channel's OWN range clears the route-range + fresh-selection-sample readiness gate (C1g) on both arms -- so the channel's own range GENUINELY reached the selection-authority accumulator this time, not an unrelated proxy channel -- but the differentiated rule_state STILL adds no marginal committed-class diversity. This cleanly REFUTES H1 (selection-authority coupling gap) as the ceiling: the coupling gap is NOT the cause, since routing the correct channel's own range did not convert. NOT a MECH-309 / ARC-062 falsification (both FAIL branches are pre-registered non_contributory in the fanout design). non_contributory; portfolio weight shifts to H2 (Leg P-B, F-dominance) / H3 (Leg P-C, competence). Do NOT weaken the claims.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_C1_substrate_not_ready_requeue: The committed-class axis was not exercisable, and/or GAP-A consumed-summary divergence was absent, and/or ARM_ON did not mature a differentiated pool (frac_active < 0.30), and/or propagation was vacuous (ARM_ON bias == ARM_OFF), and/or the MECH-448 demotion lever was vacuous (envelope inactive or all-admit excluded_count==0 on a flat-F pool), and/or the MECH-449 active No-Go was vacuous (constitution inactive or nothing suppressed -- the perseveration axis never crossed gng_perseveration_floor), and/or (NEW C1g) the lateral_pfc-routed range or the fresh-selection sample was inadequate on either arm -- the H1 test could not be run cleanly this cycle. The falsifier could not run -- NOT a MECH-309 / ARC-062 falsification. Route to substrate enrichment / re-queue; do NOT weaken the claims.
